author: iFixit
description:
If your Switch 2 Joy-Cons start drifting, Nintendo will tell you to recalibrate them. But recalibration is a temporary solution, so I’m going a step further—I’m upgrading these joysticks with Gulkit’s drift-resistant TMR modules. 

Get your Switch 2 Gulikit TMR modules!
Coming Soon!

Be sure to follow the guides for each Joy-Con!
